# Synthetic N2K fixtures

`everett-pt-townsend.log` is a candump-format log (`(secs) can0 ID#DATA`) generated by
`plotter/tools/synth_n2k.py`. Regenerate it from the repo root with:

```bash
python3 -I plotter/tools/synth_n2k.py --canboat third_party/canboat/canboat.json --out plotter/tests/fixtures/n2k/everett-pt-townsend.log
```

Output is deterministic. Replay it through n2kd:

```bash
build/n2kd/n2kd --replay plotter/tests/fixtures/n2k/everett-pt-townsend.log --speed 0 --stdout --pgns third_party/canboat/canboat.json
```

## Scenario `everett-pt-townsend` (20 minutes, start t=1798000000.0)

- Own ship, source 1, 3.0866 m/s (6 kn) through (47.98, -122.23), (47.99, -122.30), (48.05, -122.45),
  (48.11, -122.75). 129025 and 129026 (COG true, SOG), 127250 (magnetic heading = COG + 0.05 rad,
  variation 0.2731 rad east) and 128267 (depth `30 + 25*sin(2*pi*s/300)` m, offset -0.3 m) at 1 Hz,
  130316 water temperature 283.15 K (instance 0, source sea) every 2 s.
- Dropouts: no 129025 or 129026 for s in [300, 315); no 128267 for s in [360, 372).
- AIS, source 2, every 10 s each, 1 to 2 km off the track, 4 to 8 kn: class A MMSI 367000001
  (129038, 129794 name "TEST TUG"), class B MMSI 367000002 (129039, 129809 name "TEST SAIL"),
  class A MMSI 367000003 (129038 only).

`plotter/tools/test_synth_n2k.py` checks these values through the real n2kd.

## Scenario `navigating` (16 minutes, start t=1798056000.0)

- Origin: generated. Regenerate: `python3 -I plotter/tools/synth_n2k.py --canboat third_party/canboat/canboat.json --scenario navigating --out plotter/tests/fixtures/n2k/navigating.log`
- Waypoints (owner, 2026-11-05): (47.9482896, -122.3136073), (47.9021326, -122.3743223), (47.9080896, -122.4492273).
  26 kn (13.3756 m/s, SOG wobbles by 0.5 kn), about 12,460 m; past the end the boat turns back along the route.
  Start 2026-12-23 20:00 UTC (noon PST), so the auto palette picks day. Heading wanders by 0.03 rad.
- AIS: the same three targets as `everett-pt-townsend`, laid along the first leg.
- Depth: 8 m rising to 120 m at 55% of the route, 20 m at 80%, 60 m at the end, plus a 0.3 m ripple. Water 283.15 K.

## Scenario `fishing` (31 minutes, start t=1798056000.0)

- Origin: generated. Regenerate: `python3 -I plotter/tools/synth_n2k.py --canboat third_party/canboat/canboat.json --scenario fishing --out plotter/tests/fixtures/n2k/fishing.log`
- Waypoints (owner, 2026-11-05): (47.7441216, -122.4728663), (47.7444076, -122.4562403), trolled back and forth
  at 3 mph (1.34112 m/s), two passes of the 1,244 m leg.
- AIS: one class A "TEST FERRY", MMSI 367000011, 12 kn on course 200 deg true, starting 800 m east and 2 km north of the first waypoint.
- Depth: `27.5 + 12.5*cos(2*pi*f)` m (15 to 40 m, f = fraction along the leg) plus a 0.2 m ripple. Water 284.15 K.

## Scenario `fishing-stopped` (10 minutes, start t=1798056000.0)

- Origin: generated. Regenerate: `python3 -I plotter/tools/synth_n2k.py --canboat third_party/canboat/canboat.json --scenario fishing-stopped --out plotter/tests/fixtures/n2k/fishing-stopped.log`
- Holds at the first fishing waypoint (owner, 2026-11-05), SOG 0, COG 0, position jitter under 1.7 m. No AIS.
- Depth: 12 m flat. Water 284.15 K.

All scenarios take `--duration-s N` to change the length.

## Relocating a recorded log

`plotter/tools/relocate_n2k.py` moves a recorded log (candump `-L` or canboat RAW) onto other waters: it
shifts every position (PGNs 129025, 129029, 129038, 129039) so the first own-ship position lands on
`--to`, and optionally rotates the track clockwise about `--to`. Other frames pass through unchanged.

A real recording to try it on is OpenSkipper's `Kees NMEA2000 Sample.log` (IJsselmeer, 2009; canboat RAW
with `2009-06-18Z09:46:01.129` timestamps, which n2kd does not read, so relocate it first), from https://github.com/OpenSkipper/SampleLogs (25 MB). Its license is CC BY-SA 3.0 plus a requirement that
derivative works be public, which does not fit this repository, so it is not committed. Download it, then put it on Possession Sound:

```bash
python3 -I plotter/tools/relocate_n2k.py "Kees NMEA2000 Sample.log" kees-possession.log --to 47.9482896,-122.3136073 --rotate 0 --canboat third_party/canboat/canboat.json
plotter/tools/run-dev.sh kees-possession.log
```
